title: Core admission details: evaluator model bounds, legacy policy normalization, exact preflight key, run- and item-scoped attempt keys
outcome: Core admission details: evaluator model bounds, legacy policy normalization, exact preflight key, run- and item-scoped attempt keys
acceptance: a direct store write with an evaluator model segment over 128 bytes, empty, or containing a control character is refused with no feed effect
a policy with an empty mode list normalizes mechanical_basis and require_source_freshness to their defaults and a test proves requested, stored, and read policies agree
the content-derived attempt key includes the active run id and explicit keys are scoped to the work item; a test drives the supported reopen transition and shows a fresh record rather than a replay
the preflight projection carries the exact final attempt key (explicit and content-derived forms) and a test asserts equality with the recorded key

completion.summary: Evaluator model bounds enforced at the core write boundary (EvaluatorModel::validate, shared with the word parser); an empty mode list normalizes to the legacy default so requested, stored (bytes omit the field), and read policies agree; the service preflight projects the exact recorded attempt key; explicit keys are scoped explicit:<work_id>:<key> (same key on another item is a new attempt, exact same-item resend replays, contradicting same-item payload refuses) and the content key includes the run id. Per #2586 the post-commit budget failure premise is labeled unproven with no RED claimed, and the new-run reachability claim is narrowed to cover the restored first execution. RED logs/08, GREEN logs/11 and 12; docs R8/R9, B24/B38/B39.
